blocks.html:
Builds policies for a list of resources. Every policy is derived, so `key`,
`name` and `description` cannot be given.

types.name: resource
types.description: The resources to build policies for.

types.name: operation
types.description:
The operation(s) to build a policy per resource for. Defaults to the core
operations ([CORE_POLICY_OPERATIONS](/references/modules/utils#core_policy_operations)).
